composition_variation: Show Usagi Tsukino from Sailor Moon taking a peaceful garden walk in a fully covering white sweater, blue knee-length pleated skirt, tights, and simple shoes. Preserve her distinctive twin buns and long blonde pigtails. She holds a small closed lavender notebook at her side. Use dreamy pastel cel shading, soft floral bokeh, pearl highlights, and an innocent cheerful expression without magical equipment. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
